item.title: Domain expertise has always been the real moat
item.description:

item.title: Accenture to acquire Ookla
item.description:
📝 By integrating Ookla’s data products, including Speedtest®, Downdetector®, Ekahau®, and RootMetrics®, Accenture will help Communications Service Providers (CSPs), hyperscalers, and enterprises optimize the mission-critical Wi-Fi and 5G networks that power their digital core. “With the Ookla portfolio, we will offer end-to-end network intelligence services essential for AI-based transformation,” said Manish Sharma, chief strategy and services officer, Accenture. Visit us at accenture.
🔗 Read more: https://newsroom.accenture.com/news/2026/accenture-to-acquire-ookla-to-strengthen-network-intelligence-and-experience-with-data-and-ai-for-enterprises

item.title: Jef Raskin, the Visionary Behind the Mac (2013)
item.description:
📝 JW: Several people have suggested that whilst you are indisputably the father of the Mac, it would have been a significantly different machine had it followed your original plans. Some have argued, for instance, that it would have had a text interface. But it’s the interface that needs fixing.
🔗 Read more: https://lowendmac.com/2013/jef-raskin-the-visionary-behind-the-mac/

item.title: Show HN: 500 years of Joseon court omens as an observability dashboard
item.description:
📝 ops — Joseon court observability ☶ omen. opsSYSTEM NOTICE The Joseon court — the dynasty that ruled Korea for five centuries (1392–1897) — watched and recorded eclipses, comets, droughts, floods, and tiger incursions as signs bearing on the Mandate of Heaven: Heaven's read on whether the dynasty should stand. This console logs those readings as operational telemetry — every entry a real record from the 朝鮮王朝實錄.
🔗 Read more: https://ajin.im/is/building/omen.ops/
